summary: Reproduced the compressed-tensors NEXTN construction failure with a real minimal W4A8 Linear config. Improved the exception to retain the MTP module prefix, matched target, format, weight quantization, and activation quantization, with storage-aware ignore guidance. This is an error-message improvement, not a startup fix when dense MTP weights are omitted from quantization_config.ignore.

remaining_limitations: The startup failure remains for dense MTP checkpoint weights when a broad Linear target matches and the checkpoint config does not explicitly ignore the MTP prefix; the change makes that failure actionable but does not claim to resolve it.

Scheme selection occurs during module construction, before checkpoint tensor names are available, so it cannot safely distinguish dense .weight storage from genuinely quantized weight_packed/weight_scale storage and must not auto-dequantize by prefix.

No full Qwen NEXTN checkpoint was available locally, so full server startup was not run. The actual checked-out constructor and quantization implementation were exercised with a minimal real CompressedTensorsConfig and ReplicatedLinear.
No native source changed; native rebuild was not applicable.
